originalReview.notes: The photograph’s separately annotated background shows the masonry aqueduct as a continuous flat slab on many narrow stone piers, with straight safety rails and stone shoulders.

quallaSearch.notes: The cleared Byewash photograph has a separately identified background view of this aqueduct. Luitk was the sole uploader and made the first-person public-domain release in revision 5253959. The original exact bytes and the file annotation were checked.
